text:
alex: Starting prod deploy for traffic-router v2. Plan: soft warmup + attenuation for feature flag `route_v2` across regions. Sequence: US (1% -> 5% -> 20%), EU (1% -> 10%), APAC (1% -> 10%). total soak ≈ 40m. @deploy-bot kick off when ready.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: traffic-router@v2 -> prod. Will post milestones. Root ts=1767891234.

maya: Thanks. Health gates we care about: p50 latency delta < 30ms, p95 < 150ms, 5xx rate < 0.5% (5m rolling). If any gate trips, hold and notify. Also enable debug logs for routing.trace=on for 10m.

jin: +1. Also suggest pinning model-routing to 1.2.0 for the first 20% to avoid model-version drift. I'll run the pin now.

jin: `./tools/flagctl pin --service model-routing --version 1.2.0 --until 1767896034` -> pinned.

sre-oncall: Oncall here. I'll watch infra, ETA to escalate if CPU spike. If latency p50 jumps > 60ms or 5xx > 1% hold the ramp and call rollback.

alex: Rollback procedure (if needed): 1) disable `route_v2` (set percent=0), 2) abort deploy job, 3) unpin any temp pins. Quick CLI: ```bash
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \"https://console/internal/flags/route_v2\" -d '{"percent":0}'
deployctl cancel --job 1767891234
```

deploy-bot: milestone: step 1 completed at 1767891300 — route_v2 set to 1% in US. No deploy errors reported. Next step scheduled in 10m.

maya: Telemetry check @ 1% (US): p50 +3ms, p95 +8ms, 5xx=0.02%. Good to proceed to 5%.

jin: Pin still in place, model-routing v1.2.0 serving canary traffic. No regressions in unit-run tests.

alex: Proceeding to 5% US now. Will monitor the alerts channel and tracer.

sre-oncall: Noting: network queue depth in us-west increased ~12% but still within SLO. Watching.

deploy-bot: milestone: US -> 5% applied at 1767891380. Next attenuation to 20% scheduled in 10m unless hold.

maya: Quick smoke: no NPEs and no timeouts. sampling looks clean.

alex: If everything stays green at 20% we keep the soft attenuation to 20% for 15m then ramp EU to 1% and run similar warmup. APAC will remain at 0% until EU passes.

sre-oncall: If p95 > 200ms at any step, hold and notify infra. I'll reopen pager if error trends look systemic.

deploy-bot: milestone: US -> 20% applied at 1767891445. No automated rollback triggers.

jin: Observability check: traces show expected route_v2 path, no added retries. Metric diffs: p50 +6ms, p95 +12ms, errors unchanged.

alex: Great — holding 20% for 15m soak before EU 1%. Will post an update at next milestone. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks team. tagging post-deploy notes: add release note that `route_v2` uses attenuation warmup; mention pin of model-routing -> 1.2.0 for first day.

sre-oncall: I'll keep monitoring. If anything odd ping me directly.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete for initial warmup phase. Final status: US at 20%, EU/APAC at 0%. Next action window at 1767892345 for EU 1% (manual go).
